query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "jumlah!"
        FROM transactions t
        WHERE t.status = 'completed'
          AND ($1::date IS NULL
               OR t.created_at >= $1::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta')
          AND ($2::date IS NULL
               OR t.created_at < ($2::date + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta')
